source.title: Some open problems in complex and harmonic analysis: report on problem session held during the conference Completeness problems, Carleson measures, and spaces of analytic functions

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 6767121. Local output indexes mapped the record to DOI 10.1090/conm/679/13678 and OpenAlex work W4233165430.

Failure mode: metadata_only/paywalled_or_restricted. The zbMATH page and API could not be resolved to readable full text in the local shell environment (DNS failure for api.zbmath.org) and web fetch exposed only resolver or terms metadata. AMS bookstore/eBook pages identified Contemporary Mathematics volume 679 and the chapter title, but exposed only book metadata, table of contents, purchase/PDF link labels, and no readable chapter text. Exact-title, DOI, AMS, OpenAlex, and zbMATH searches did not recover a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source. ResearchGate results exposed only a chapter listing/abstract and related papers; PDFDrive appeared only as search-result snippets and was not accepted as a primary source. Unrelated citing articles were rejected because they did not contain the source problem statements.

No candidate questions were extracted because the only accessible materials were resolver metadata, abstracts, table-of-contents entries, search snippets, or citing-paper references; extracting from those would violate the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-6767121.json and outputs/latest.json.
